issues.title: Editor for SIDC codes
issues.body:
For the `sidc` field, we're currently just taking a string parameter.

This is quite user-hostile.  Instead we should offer a lookup of known SIDC codes.  _Somehow_ extract these from the MilSym documentation

Or a popup form dialog that lets the user set the different parameters.  There are a few instances of this online:
* https://spatialillusions.com/unitgenerator/#30031000000000000000
* https://www.spatialillusions.com/unitgenerator-legacy/
* https://www.symbol.army/symbol

We have two options:
- find a way to embed one of the above as static pages within Serge, so users can switch tab to the SIDC generator and gneerate a new code
- find a way to extract the data from one of the above, so we can create a popup dialog box that includes the series of drop-downs that the above present.
